steps.en: The latest mobile number of each driver is fetched from the government data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru tiap driver diambil dari sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The lookup is written but switched off in every environment setting in the repo, so the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian sudah ditulis tetapi dimatikan di semua pengaturan environment di repo, jadi nomor lama yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each driver is identified once and their unpaid notices are combined into one message
steps.id: Tiap driver diidentifikasi sekali dan notice yang belum dibayar digabung dalam satu pesan
steps.why_en: Notices are only combined when stage and due date are the same; otherwise the driver gets several messages.
steps.why_id: Notice hanya digabung bila tahap dan tanggal jatuh temponya sama; kalau tidak, driver menerima beberapa pesan.

steps.en: The message lists the unpaid notices and points to the 1st reminder letter
steps.id: Pesan memuat notice yang belum dibayar dan merujuk surat pengingat ke-1
steps.why_en: The wording of the stored template cannot be checked from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi kalimat template tersimpan tidak bisa dicek dari code.

steps.en: The messages are sent to drivers in one batch run
steps.id: Pesan dikirim ke driver dalam satu proses batch
steps.why_en: The sending code exists, but the repo settings turn SMS and the scheduled run off in production.
steps.why_id: Code pengirim ada, tetapi pengaturan di repo mematikan SMS dan proses terjadwalnya di produksi.
